title: Spytime
desc: Anacleto, a former secret agent, is forced to come out of retirement and protect his son, Adolfo, when his arch-enemy, Vazquez, breaks out of prison and targets him

title: The Free Fall
desc: The Free Fall is a deeply personal horror thriller, a mind bending pressure cooker that constantly challenges us, hurling us towards one of the most shocking cinematic reveals imaginable. After attempting to take her own life, a young woman must wrestle with an overbearing husband and the only way out of this hell, is to fall into it.

title: Maneater
desc: While the group of friends explore a beautiful small island, all hell breaks loose for Jessie as the rogue shark sets its hunting grounds within the vicinity. A Father with a score to settle brings his war to their doorstep.

title: Room 203
desc: Many residents of ROOM 203 have disappeared since the murder suicide of a married couple exactly fifty years ago. Lifelong friends Kim and Izzy and roommates are terrified by the vengeful spirits dwelling in their apartment. To save Izzy's life, Kim may need to sacrifice her own. Based on the Internationally Bestselling novel by Kamon Nanami.

title: Wrecker
desc: Two beautiful young women taking a trip through the countryside, are terrorized by an unknown driver trying to run them down in a heavy duty tow truck.
